title: Goat OS — Frontend RUM (admin-web)
description: Browser RUM dashboard. Current live status: admin-web code contains FaroProvider and traceparent propagation, but the deployed goatos-admin-web-stg revision does not set NEXT_PUBLIC_FARO_COLLECTOR_URL, and goatos-stg-grafana-alloy has no request_count series in the last 24h. Cloud Run/Grafana health panels remain useful once traffic arrives; RUM web-vitals/error panels stay as explicit gaps until the build env and Cloud Trace/Logging visualization path are completed.

panels.title: RUM ingestion pipeline health (pending browser traffic)
Grafana Alloy (faro.receiver) request rate by status class
panels.description: run.googleapis.com/request_count on the goatos-stg-grafana-alloy Cloud Run service, grouped by response_code_class — confirms the RUM receiver endpoint itself is reachable and healthy before trusting any Faro-derived panel. Metric type + grouping verified live against this Grafana instance (using the sibling goatos-stg-grafana service as a known-good reference, since Alloy has not received any Faro traffic yet).

panels.title: Grafana Alloy request latency p50 / p99
panels.description: run.googleapis.com/request_latencies (a DELTA/DISTRIBUTION metric) on goatos-stg-grafana-alloy. GCP Cloud Monitoring's percentile aligner supports only p50/p95/p99 (ALIGN_PERCENTILE_90 is rejected by the API, verified live) — p99 shown here, p95 would stand in for p90 if needed.

panels.title: Web Vitals + JS errors + traces (pending Faro wiring + Cloud Trace/Logging datasources)
Web Vitals (LCP / CLS / INP / TTFB) — pending RUM metrics pipeline

options.content: **Pending RUM metrics pipeline.** Code has `FaroProvider`, but the deployed `goatos-admin-web-stg` revision currently lacks `NEXT_PUBLIC_FARO_COLLECTOR_URL`, so browser sessions cannot POST to Alloy. After rebuilding admin-web with that URL, verify `run.googleapis.com/request_count` for `goatos-stg-grafana-alloy` and Cloud Trace browser root spans before treating Web Vitals as live. Web Vitals arrive as Faro/OTel telemetry, not as the Cloud Run request metrics used for receiver health.

panels.title: JS error rate — pending RUM metrics pipeline

options.content: **Pending RUM metrics pipeline.** Same deployment gap as Web Vitals: no live Faro collector URL in admin-web, and no Alloy request_count series in the last 24h. Once Faro traffic arrives, use Cloud Trace/Logging-backed panels or a derived metric for JS error rate.

panels.title: Slow browser -> API traces (p99 span duration) — pending Cloud Trace datasource

options.content: **Pending Cloud Trace datasource.** admin-web's API client (`packages/api-client`, fetch wrapper) already injects/propagates a W3C `traceparent` per OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md section 2.4, so once Faro tracing + a `googlecloud-trace-datasource` are both provisioned, this panel should filter `service.name="goatos-admin-web-stg"` and surface the browser span linked to its backend span on one trace — letting an operator jump from a slow page load straight to the backend API/DB spans that caused it.

panels.title: RUM session count (24h) — pending RUM metrics pipeline

options.content: **Pending RUM metrics pipeline.** Once live: Cloud Logging filter `jsonPayload.kind="session"`, count distinct session id over 24h.

panels.title: Route changes (SPA navigation, 24h) — pending RUM metrics pipeline

options.content: **Pending RUM metrics pipeline.** Once live: Cloud Logging filter `jsonPayload.kind="event" jsonPayload.name="routeChange"`, rate/5m by `jsonPayload.attributes.toUrl` (bounded to route templates, not raw query strings).

**Pending both the RUM metrics pipeline AND a geoip enrichment step.** Faro does not resolve client geo natively — this needs a `resourcedetection`/geoip processor added to the Alloy/Collector pipeline (not yet in `infra/envs/stg/observability.tf`) in addition to Faro + Cloud Logging being live.
